units.source_text: 报社围棋记者甚至说，让这样的病人下棋，不合人道主义。

en.t: Even the newspaper's Go reporter said that making such a sick man play was inhumane.

units.source_text: 但是，想方设法让名人继续对弈的正是举办告别赛的报社。

en.t: And yet it was the very newspaper sponsoring the farewell match that did everything it could to make the Master continue playing.

units.source_text: 这盘棋在报上连载，深受群众的欢迎。

en.t: The game was serialized in the newspaper and was warmly welcomed by the public.

units.source_text: 我写的观战记也取得了成功，连不谙围棋的读者都阅读了。

en.t: The match reports I wrote were also a success, and even readers who knew nothing about Go read them.
Someone also quietly said to me:

units.source_text: 名人可能担心这盘棋半途而废，庞大的开销怎么办？

en.t: Perhaps the Master was worried that if the game were abandoned halfway, what would become of the enormous expenses?

units.source_text: 这种胡乱猜疑未免过于牵强。

en.t: This sort of groundless speculation was surely far too forced.
